verdict.rationale: ClickUp lists Time Tracking as one of its own products, and its MCP server docs state it can log time entries and manage timers, so native time logging exists. The evidence never says those entries attach to specific tasks or projects. Missing for 10: documentation that time entries are logged against tasks and projects, a description of the in-app time tracking UI or workflow, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can log time directly against tasks and projects

citations.quote: **Track time**: Log time entries and manage timers.
